crosscheck_findings.claim: Static serving should not require provisioning during impairment.
crosscheck_findings.resolution: Current AWS guidance retains pre-provisioning and local state; application discovery, credentials and update dependencies still need project inspection.

crosscheck_findings.claim: Historical article uses NAT as a zonal foundation.
crosscheck_findings.resolution: Current zonal and regional modes differ. Regional expansion may take up to 60 minutes with temporary cross-zone routing; private NAT remains zonal.
Multi-AZ DB-instance failover still needs existing connections re-established and appropriate DNS cache behavior.
Current guidance includes failure consequences, risk tolerance, RTO/RPO and cost-benefit analysis; illustrative numeric targets are not defaults.
Example policy has scoped-user and emergency/security exceptions. Its four-week window and thresholds are not adopted.

crosscheck_findings.claim: Retry plus buffering avoids transient loss.
crosscheck_findings.resolution: Retries are enabled by default but elapsed budget expires; queue is in-memory unless storage is configured; overflow can return retryable error; component health does not establish delivery.
Prometheus remote-write WAL is component-specific; truncation/retention can remove unsent samples. No uniform logs/traces durability follows.

crosscheck_findings.claim: GC CPU pressure triggers protective scale-out.
crosscheck_findings.resolution: GOMEMLIMIT is soft, omits non-runtime memory, and can be exceeded; live queues cannot be collected. Proposed scaling reaction requires measured verification.
Utilization is relative to requests; HPA is intermittent and depends on metrics. Usable new capacity still requires readiness and schedulable nodes.

crosscheck_findings.claim: Any refused span means terminal drop.
crosscheck_findings.resolution: Metrics record stage outcomes. Upstream limiter returns non-permanent errors; final preservation depends on predecessor retry/retention. Names depend on export format and version.

recommendation.reason: All three triggers fit existing operational design. Add conditional depth and navigation instead of a broad overlapping SRE package.

verification_scenarios.setup: Finite measured workload on warmed replicas across declared domains, with an explicit stale-state policy.
schedule: Remove one domain while provisioning and configuration updates are denied.
Compare a design that requires replacement startup.
Expire a required local configuration/credential and verify the declared safety policy.
verification_scenarios.oracle: Successful eligible operations, latency, survivor saturation, actual control calls, safe stale-state behavior and update resumption.
verification_scenarios.passing_control: Adequate ready survivors within the measured workload and a valid retained-state contract.
verification_scenarios.failing_control: Survivors require replacement launch or fetch missing configuration.
verification_scenarios.limits: A local model cannot establish AWS fault-domain isolation or real client reconnection.

verification_scenarios.setup: Two reliability options with declared costs and user-outcome measurements.
schedule: Include an improvement that raises aggregate success but misses a critical cohort.
Compare a cohort-targeted option under the same window.
Introduce an integrity failure that is outside the availability budget.
verification_scenarios.oracle: Decision retains cohort evidence and integrity constraint, prices failure consequences, and records reversible assumptions.
verification_scenarios.passing_control: Objective/cost tradeoff can be reproduced from supplied measurements.
verification_scenarios.failing_control: Highest replica count or average uptime chosen without user/cost evidence.
verification_scenarios.limits: Hypothetical cost comparison is not a deployed reliability or financial result.

verification_scenarios.setup: Finite spans with stable test identities, explicit sender retention, exporter queue/retry settings and independent diagnostic route.
schedule: Rate-limit the sink until queue pressure appears.
Restart the gateway with in-memory and configured-persistent queue alternatives.
Expire a retry window and include a sender that retries a refusal.
Recover the sink and measure catch-up.
verification_scenarios.oracle: Source/admission/sink identity reconciliation, duplicates/loss, resource bounds, diagnostic continuity and recovery deadline.
verification_scenarios.passing_control: Expected delivery or explicit bounded loss matches the chosen contract, with stage evidence still available.
verification_scenarios.failing_control: Accepted count alone is reported as delivery, or health telemetry uses the saturated gateway.
verification_scenarios.limits: Runtime verification needs actual binary, storage volume, sink contract and authorized environment; no experiment ran.
